title: Fix error when selecting item as the line type in German language
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when selecting an item as the line type in German language versions of Business Central on blanket sales order forms.
key_points: Error in German language blanket sales order line type selection has been corrected
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (W1, CH, NA, NO)
Test case added to validate the option lookup buffer behavior
Issue tracked as AB#644921 requiring backport to version 28.x
